entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
By the oath of those (winds) which cause scattering, flying.
Then by the oath of those which carry the burdens (of clouds).
Then by the oath of those (ships) which move with ease.
Then by the oath of those (groups of angels) who distribute by command.
Undoubtedly, what you are promised is definitely true.
And undoubtedly, justice will certainly be done.
And by the oath of the decorated heaven.
You are in various contradictions (regarding the the Beloved Prophet Muhammad and this Qur'aan).
Only he is made to turn away from the Qur'aan who is destined to be turned away.
Death to those who falsely assume.
Those who have forgotten (the Hereafter) in the intoxication (of ignorance).
They ask, 'When will be the Day of justice?'
(O Beloved, say to them) 'It will be on that Day when they will be burning in the Fire.'
And it will be said to them, 'Taste your own burning; this is what you were hastening to.'
Indeed, the pious are in gardens and springs.
Receiving the rewards granted by their Lord, they were indeed virtuous before this.
They would sleep less during the night.
And would seek forgiveness in the latter part of the night.
And in their wealth, there was the right of the beggar and the deprived.
And in the earth are signs for those who are certain (in their faith).
And in your own selves (are signs), so do you not perceive?
And in the heaven is your sustenance, and that which you are promised.
So, by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, this Qur'aan is indeed the truth, in exactly the same language that you speak.
Did the news of Ibrahim's honourable guests reach you (O Beloved)?
When they came to him, (and) said, 'Salaam.' He (also) answered, 'Salaam.' (And said) 'These people are strangers.'
Then he went to his home, so he brought a healthy (roasted) calf.
He then presented it before them, (and) said, 'Do you not eat?'
So, he inwardly began fearing them. They said, 'Do not fear.' And they gave him the glad tidings of a knowledgeable son.
His wife came screaming, then struck her forehead and said, 'What! An old infertile woman (will give birth to a child)?'
They said (to the wife of Ibrahim), 'This is how your Lord has commanded; indeed, only He is the Wise, the All-Knowing.'
Said Ibrahim, 'So, for what purpose have you come, O angels?'
They said, 'We have been sent towards a sinful nation.'
'That we may throw upon them stones of baked clay.'
'Which are marked (bearing the names of those to be killed), kept ready with your Lord, for the transgressors.'
So, We removed the people who had faith from that town.
So, there We found just one Muslim household.
And We kept a sign remaining therein, for those who fear the painful punishment.
And (also kept a sign) in Moosa when We sent him with clear proof towards Fir'awn.
Consequently, he turned away along with his army and said, 'He (Moosa) is a magician or a mad man.'
We henceforth seized him and his army and put them into the river, in the state that he was blaming himself.
And in the (tribe of) 'Aad (is a sign) when We sent a dry windstorm upon them.
And whatever it passed through, it caused it to turn to ruin.
And (there is a sign) in the (nation of) Thamood when it was said to them, 'Enjoy for a while.'
So, they rebelled against the command of their Lord, a thunderbolt therefore seized them in front of their eyes.
So, they were neither able to stand up, nor were they able to take revenge.
And before them, We destroyed the nation of Nooh; indeed, they were sinning people.
And We have built the heaven with the hands (of Divine Power), and it is We Who give vastness.
And We spread out the earth, so how excellent We are at spreading (it).
And We created all things in pairs, that you may ponder.
'So, run towards Allah; indeed, I am from Him, a clear warner for you.'
'And do not associate other deities along with Allah; indeed, I am from Him, a clear warner for you.'
Likewise, when a Messenger came to those before them, so they said this; that 'He is a magician or a mad man.'
Did they make a will of this utterance (of belying the Prophets) to one another? Rather, they are rebellious people.
Therefore, turn away from them, O Beloved, so there is no blame upon you.
And give advice (i.e. remind), that giving advice benefits the Muslims.
And I have created Jinn and human beings only for this, that they should worship Me.
I do not ask any sustenance from them, nor do I want that they give Me food.
Indeed, only Allah is the Great Provider, the Mighty, the Powerful.
And indeed, for those wrongdoers is a turn of punishment like there was a turn for their companions (in disbelief), so they must not ask Me to hasten (the punishment).
So, woe to the disbelievers from (the coming of) that Day of theirs which they are promised.
